newsitem.title: USA: Reuters 10-yr muni GO bond index at 4.74 pct.
newsitem.headline: Reuters 10-yr muni GO bond index at 4.74 pct.

text.p: Reuters said Thursday its 10-year tax-exempt general obligation bond index was 4.74 percent, up 11 basis points from last Thursday.
The weekly index, calculated every Thursday, MUNINDEX03 represents the non-weighted average yield on 15 state and local municipal bonds of 10-year maturity and ratings ranging from A-minus to AAA.

The issues are from Maryland; North Carolina; Texas Permanent School Fund; Columbus, Ohio; Fairfax County, Va.; Connecticut; Florida Board of Education; Wisconsin; Atlanta, Georgia; Shelby County, Tenn.; California; New York State; Pennsylvania; Dade County, Fla. and Tucson, Ariz.
